Orbit Privacy Policy

Last updated: 16 November 2026

Orbit ("the app") lets friends and family share their live location, battery level and messages with people they choose. This policy explains what the app collects, why, and the choices you have. Orbit is developed by Arpan. Contact: arpangaur2007@gmail.com.

What we collect

  • Account information: your name, email address (or Google account email), a username and a friend code you create.
  • Precise location, including in the background when you turn on sharing and choose "Allow all the time". This is the core feature: it lets the friends and group members you approve see where you are, even when the app is closed.
  • Location history for about the last 24 hours, used to show your recent trail and timeline to people you share with.
  • Battery level and charging status, shown to people you share with.
  • Messages you send in chats and groups.
  • Saved places you create (for arrive/leave alerts) and, optionally, your phone number so friends can call you.

How we use it

  • To show your location, battery and messages only to people you accept as friends (and choose to share with) or who are in a group you joined.
  • To send alerts such as arrived/left a place, low battery, SOS, and "ring my phone".
  • We do not sell your data, use it for advertising, or share it with data brokers.

Where it is stored

Data is stored in Google Firebase (Realtime Database and Authentication), operated by Google, with security rules so that only you and the people you allow can read your location. Data is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS).

Optional AI features

If you turn on AI features, recent locations, battery levels, saved places and message text of the people on your map are sent to Google Gemini to produce summaries, answers and reply suggestions. AI is off unless you agree, and you can turn it off at any time in Settings.

Your choices

  • Pause sharing with everyone using one switch, or turn off sharing for any single friend.
  • A notification is always shown while sharing is on.
  • Unfriend people or leave groups at any time.
  • Sign out to stop sharing from that phone.
  • Delete your account and data: email arpangaur2007@gmail.com from your account email, and your account, location, history, places, friends and messages will be deleted within 30 days.

Retention

Your latest location is kept while your account exists. Location history older than about 26 hours is removed automatically. Other data is kept until you delete it or request account deletion.

Children

Orbit is not directed at children under 13, and should only be used to share location with people who agree to it. Never install it on someone's phone without their knowledge and consent.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
